name: CloudBeaver Community
about: Manage PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, and other supported databases in your browser. On first start, complete the server setup and create the administrator account. For a database container on this server with a published port, enter host.docker.internal in the connection's Host field and the published host port in its Port field. Ports published only on localhost cannot be reached this way.

variables.label: Workspace folder
variables.description: CloudBeaver settings and workspace files. Startup changes this folder and its contents to UID:GID 8978:8978, so use a dedicated folder.

variables.label: Web UI port
variables.description: Host port for the web UI.
